attribution_limitations: Admission hemoglobin is printed as 12.5 g/dL in the case text ('on admission') and as 12.80 in the Table 1 Admission column: the same stated time point with two different numbers (12.80 is not a rounding of 12.5), so it is a source conflict. Both sides are review_only; neither value is used in the summary.

Imaging interpretation differs between teams: the ultrasound was concerning for acalculous cholecystitis and the MRCP was consistent with acute cholecystitis, while IR believed the imaging was not consistent with acalculous cholecystitis. No final cholecystitis diagnosis is stated.

The narrative values for BUN, creatinine, total and direct bilirubin and platelets "over the course of the next three days" equal the Table 1 Day 3 column, but 'the next three days' (a span following the IVC-filter sentence) is not literally the 'Day 3' column time, so text and table are kept as separate observations (matching numbers alone never merge). The start of the three-day span is not stated relative to admission.
The Table 1 Direct bilirubin Admission cell is printed as a dash (no value); no admission direct bilirubin is recorded.
Creatine kinase unit is IU/L in the case text and U/L in the Table 1 reference range; treated as one admission measurement (print variant).

The Discussion states Zosyn was the only intervention that produced clinical improvement and that the leptospirosis was susceptible to it; this is the authors' attribution and is not recorded as a fact or a temporal link.
